assets.title: 指控与原稿
assets.description: Night glass conference room, Ava stands hurt but defiant holding notebook; Veronica beside projector accusing her, Blake seated patronizing half-smile, Ethan at glass door scrutinizing accusation. Unopened champagne and proposal pages. No verdict yet.

assets.title: 谁也不能关掉证据
assets.description: Same night meeting room, Veronica reaches toward laptop lid, Ethan calmly lays an empty paper folder between her hand and laptop without touching her. Ava faces Veronica with steady challenging gaze. Screen abstract thumbnails.

assets.title: 把原稿留在桌上
assets.description: Night meeting room, three loose printed proposal pages and an OPEN empty evidence envelope on table. Ava studies papers, Ethan holds out her employee badge, Veronica tense and Blake by open door. Envelope remains open, no completed verdict shown.

assets.title: 被拦下的停职
assets.description: Morning meeting room, Veronica slides a red-edged unsigned personnel document forward, Ethan calmly closes a pen cap, Ava stands upright, watching suspiciously. Laptop beside them shows abstract audit log grid.

assets.title: 总裁主动退开
assets.description: Daylit office, Ethan slides his chair back from a personnel review document while Ava sits in the central decision seat holding audit papers, thoughtful determination. Wide respectful distance; restrained serious expressions.

assets.title: 账号换约会的交易
assets.description: Office doorway, Blake leans on doorframe with ingratiating smile and open palm, Ava keeps distance with firm wary eyes and closed laptop in hand, Ethan further back by workstation. Screens dim, no physical contact.

assets.title: 一百万的陷阱
assets.description: Meeting room, Blake offers thick unsigned settlement folder with gold pen and smug smile, Veronica watches with tight confident lips, Ava reads fine print skeptically, Ethan waits quietly to side. No readable monetary text.

assets.title: 她不肯低头
assets.description: At office conference table, Blake leans forward pressing for answer, Ava holds her own copy close, chin raised, steady refusal, open space between them. Gold pen lies unused.

assets.title: 签名页的破绽
assets.description: Office desk, two almost identical unsigned agreement copies side by side. Ava traces a difference with finger, Veronica grips watch strap nervously, Ethan studies discrepancy. Neither sheet torn, no final signature.

assets.title: 雨夜的两杯茶
assets.description: 10pm rainy Manhattan office, two steaming tea cups across desk, Ethan gently slides one cup toward Ava leaving half desk distance, she studies him cautiously, soft intimate but professional lighting.

assets.title: 那把紫雨伞
assets.description: Rainy night desk, open notebook with small purple umbrella sticker, Ethan notices it with startled brow, Ava examines his face with sudden suspicious recognition. Two tea cups and face-down phone. No touch.

assets.title: 由她写下边界
assets.description: Rainy night office, Ava writes in her own notebook beside blank boundary worksheet; Ethan sits a respectful distance hands away from paper, small accepting smile. Phone with tiny abstract notification glow beside him, no readable messages.

assets.title: 被改掉的名牌
assets.description: Luxury hotel client dinner corner, only four known adults visible. Ava in cream blouse charcoal blazer holds generic blank place card, hurt but composed. Veronica proudly beside her own card, Blake holding wine with patronizing smile, Ethan frowns at misattributed credit. Warm chandeliers.

assets.title: 她拿回发言权
assets.description: Hotel dinner presentation alcove, Ava stands with microphone held at chest height and evidence folder ready, determined eyes; Blake tense jaw, Veronica brittle smile, Ethan to side listening. No crowd or additional faces. Do not imply chosen public route is mandatory; microphone rests on stand within reach rather than in her hand.

assets.title: 迟来的署名更正
assets.description: Hotel banquet corner with reflective wall, Ava reviews cover sheet calmly, Ethan stands between her and distant flash glare without touching, Blake turns his wineglass with frustrated smile. Original author dispute still pending, no celebration.

assets.title: 被恶意截图围住
assets.description: Morning office meeting, four smartphones glowing on table, Ava distressed but upright, Veronica judgmental glance, Blake feigned concern, Ethan firmly places his phone face down. Projection abstract chat bubbles no words.

assets.title: 私生活不是证据
assets.description: Meeting table, Ava keeps personal phone screen toward herself with assertive chin, Ethan hands visibly away from phone, openly listening. A separate printed abstract screenshot lies on table for verification, not all chats exposed.

assets.title: 看见拼接的白线
assets.description: Office projection workstation, Ava examines printed screenshot with noticeable white seam between abstract chat panels, expression focused confidence; Blake anxious sideways glance, Ethan attentive beside her. Computer shows anonymous abstract routing dots, no names.

assets.title: 收起万能门卡
assets.description: Executive office daylight, Ethan puts premium access card into partly open drawer, Ava watches thoughtfully holding notes; Veronica across desk impatient. Card is not handed to Ava, procedural fairness.

assets.title: 她画自己的路径
assets.description: Office whiteboard, Ava with marker drawing four simple blank boxes and connecting arrows, concentrated empowered expression, Ethan stands aside returning another marker to tray. Abstract routing map, no readable text or selected route implied.

assets.title: 复制出来的授权
assets.description: Neutral records review room with desk lamp and shelving, Ava and Ethan compare two nearly identical approval papers, each marked with abstract signature strokes and faint rectangular paste edge. Ava skeptical, Ethan concerned, no extra people.

assets.title: 漏洞也有他的责任
assets.description: Neutral document review room, receipt and old printed permissions page both closed on table, Ava questions Ethan directly, he listens with lowered defensive posture and accountable serious expression. No route-specific winner, neither receipt nor archive is exclusive focus.

assets.title: 一句真正的道歉
assets.description: Office records desk, disputed signature photocopy with faint paste rectangle between them, Ava upright holding her copy, Ethan sincerely apologetic with relaxed open hands, Veronica defensive at far edge. No forgiving embrace or verdict.

assets.title: 紫伞书签的主人
assets.description: Quiet rainy meeting room, Ethan places small purple umbrella-shaped bookmark on desk, Ava startled with breath caught, both face visible and restrained attraction. Two seated adults, no touch, no phone spying.

assets.title: 现实关系重新选择
assets.description: Same quiet meeting room, Ava thoughtfully meets Ethan eyes with hand resting near umbrella bookmark, Ethan sits back with patient respectful uncertainty. No touching, no romance acceptance or rejection predetermined.

assets.title: 门外的陌生打印纸
assets.description: Glass meeting room, Ava reviews her own phone without exposing readable private chat, Ethan waits quietly a full step away; through frosted doorway Veronica holds a folded printed sheet, suspicious poised expression. No exposed explicit material.

assets.title: 隐私被当成武器
assets.description: Conference room, Veronica holds cropped printed abstract chat and points toward projection of meaningless gray chat rectangles, Ava tense but chin level, Ethan sternly objects, Blake watches uneasily. No readable private text, no intimate images.

assets.title: 她拒绝被定义
assets.description: Meeting room, Ava faces Veronica with firm direct gaze and raised open hand requesting stop, projection is dim neutral gray without private content, paper copy remains face down for evidence. Veronica surprised and unsettled.

assets.title: 水印指向打印机
assets.description: Office printer alcove, Ava studies tiny abstract watermark squares on sealed photocopy, Blake forced smile and tense hands near own phone, Ethan listens seriously. No leaked private content readable, no final culprit inference.

assets.title: 没有签名栏的清单
assets.description: After-hours office lounge one warm lamp, Ava and Ethan seated across low table with blank three-column boundary worksheet and tea, Ethan hands open calm, Ava alert and thoughtful. Two adults fully clothed, no touch or intimate action.

assets.title: 拒绝也被认真听见
assets.description: Same after-hours lounge, Ava speaks with calm assertive gaze holding her own worksheet, Ethan leans slightly back listening respectfully, checklist placed within her reach. No romantic acceptance predetermined, no smile of conquest.

assets.title: 独自写下自己的边界
assets.description: After-hours lounge one warm lamp, Ava ALONE writing personal boundaries in notebook, calm autonomous thoughtful expression, empty adjacent seat, own phone glowing with tiny abstract notification. No Ethan reflection or portrait, no other people.

assets.title: 他签下回避记录
assets.description: Daylit CEO office, Ethan signs his own recusal form at desk, Ava observes critically with audit checklist, Veronica watches with tense disapproval. Not resignation, no emotional sacrifice romance.

assets.title: 七分钟的权限漏洞
assets.description: Office audit workstation, Ava and Ethan study abstract timeline with two separated endpoints on monitor, printed receipt and old permissions note on desk. Ava concentrated, Ethan sober accountable, no indication his device exported data, no culprit named.

assets.title: 拿秘密换一次约会
assets.description: Office corridor alcove at dusk, Blake holds tablet showing abstract unsent email draft and ominous red clock symbol, manipulative tight smile, Ava stands outside arm reach with guarded determined eyes. No restraint, clear exit visible.

assets.title: 她把威胁留下来
assets.description: Same corridor meeting alcove, Ava holds her own notebook documenting threat, firmly looks at Blake, he has lost confident smile; Ethan visible OUTSIDE open doorway waiting for invitation, no entering or rescue grab. Tablet stays in Blake hand.

assets.title: 爱不是欠条
assets.description: Office corridor beside open review room, Ava securely stores her own phone and threat notes in portfolio, relief mixed with firm resolve. Ethan stands a respectful step away, serious empathetic gaze, clear exit visible. Blake absent, no romance embrace, no readable threat.

assets.title: 总裁坐到旁听席
assets.description: Formal glass review room daylight, Ava central at screen with evidence folder, Ethan seated well aside as observer, Veronica seated opposite with skeptical raised chin. Ava prepares chronology sheet, no extra people.

assets.title: 最后路线由她决定
assets.description: Review room, Ava stands over two closed procedural folders neutral undecided covers, Ethan listens from side seat, Veronica avoids direct gaze. Screen abstract chronology of four blank nodes. No public audience or route outcome implied.

assets.title: 所有证据终于对上
assets.description: Office review table under neutral daylight, Ava sorts original proposal, revision logs and authorization copies into separate neat groups, focused confident expression, Ethan serious listening, not leading. No readable signatures, no premature judgment.

assets.title: 主管说出她的理由
assets.description: Review table, Veronica speaks with brittle shaken pride gripping watch strap, Ava listens steadily without forgiving smile, Ethan and Blake seated farther apart observing. Separate proposal and threat evidence stacks, no implied full conspiracy confession.

assets.title: 她提出三项纠正
assets.description: Glass review room only four known adults, Ava stands with correction draft and original proposal, Veronica across table defensive, Blake tense jaw, Ethan seated aside attentive. Neutral private-safe staging works for both public review and closed verification; no crowd, no press.

assets.title: 更正不是施舍
assets.description: Same review room, Ava carefully edits draft with pen, determined calm expression; Veronica looks down uneasily, Blake phone face down lost smile, Ethan offers small proud supportive smile from side. No signed final decision yet.

assets.title: 这次由她陈述
assets.description: Final review room, Ava stands at screen holding original proposal and orderly evidence tabs, confident composed gaze, Ethan seated nonvoting side with supportive nod, Veronica and Blake seated opposite tense. Only four adults visible, no readable screen.

assets.title: 他们终于无法否认
assets.description: Final review table, Ava holds up creative proposal folder upright with calm victorious dignity, Veronica lowered eyes ashamed, Blake smile gone staring at phone face down, Ethan seated side proud warm gaze. She leads, no physical contact.

assets.title: 名字回到作品上
assets.description: Office workstation morning, Ava seated at restored laptop holding correction letter beside backed-up portfolio, expression relieved dignified, Ethan one respectful step away with soft proud smile. Laptop generic editable author field, no readable generated text, no forced romance.

assets.title: 重新打开属于她的作品
assets.description: Bright Manhattan office morning, Ava alone at restored computer, neatly backed-up portfolio and correction letter on desk, focused peaceful expression, new notebook ready. No other people. Professional freedom, no chosen romantic ending.

assets.title: 新的一页由她来写
assets.description: Sunlit office window Manhattan skyline, Ava ALONE opening clean notebook with small purple umbrella sticker, writing her own small signature-like stroke, tranquil confident hopeful face. Packed portfolio beside her suggests open future, no partner, no forced stay or departure.
